Index of /monthly_releases/2026/pombase-2026-10-01/genome_sequence_and_features

 Name                                       Last modified      Size  Description
 Parent Directory                                                -   
 artemis_contigs/                           2026-10-01 02:00    -   
 fasta_format/                              2026-10-01 02:00    -   
 feature_coordinates/                       2026-10-01 02:00    -   
 gff_format/                                2026-10-01 02:00    -   

These directories contain sequences for genes, transcripts, proteins
and whole chromosomes along with feature coordinates in several
formats.

 - artemis_contigs
   chromosome sequence and features in enriched EMBL-based format for
   loading into Artemis, annotated by PomBase

 - fasta_format
   files in fasta format for: chromosome, gene, exon, intron,
   transcript and protein sequences

 - feature_coordinates
   per chromosome files in Tab Separated Values (TSV) format
   containing coding sequence (CDS), gene and exon locations

 - gff_format
   gene features files in GFF3 format for each chromosome, and separates files
   for forward and reverse strand features

These files are part of PomBase release 2026-10-01

For use of this dataset please cite:
  Pascal Carme, Kim Rutherford, Jürg Bähler, Juan Mata, Valerie Wood
  PomBase in 2026: Expanding Knowledge, Modelling Connections
  Genetics, January 2026
  https://doi.org/10.1093/genetics/iyag001
